title: Reconcilement Standard: Reversing an Early Withdrawal Penalty on a Certificate of Deposit
content:
A penalty assessed against a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line is reversed in full, never in part, as a single credit tied to the penalty entry it reverses.

## 1. The two grounds of reversal

**Bank error.** A penalty is reversed on this ground where it was assessed contrary to the terms of this line, namely:

- on a withdrawal taken during the grace period;
- on a penalty-free withdrawal from a certificate of the tier that publishes a waiting period, taken after that period had passed;
- on a withdrawal of interest already credited;
- at a number of days, or at a rate, other than the terms provide;
- on a sum larger than the principal the withdrawal removed.

**The death waiver.** A penalty is reversed on this ground where the bank's estate services confirm that the withdrawal followed the owner's death or adjudicated incompetence.

## 2. How often

A penalty can be reversed at most once. Whether a penalty already carries a reversal is read from the certificate's ledger, where each reversal names the penalty it belongs to.

## 3. Outside this standard

A reversal made as a goodwill gesture on a penalty that was correctly assessed is not governed here.

## 4. Points of judgement

| The penalty as assessed | Within this standard | Ground |
|---|---|---|
| charged on a withdrawal taken in the grace period | yes | bank error |
| charged at more days than the terms provide | yes | bank error |
| charged on a sum exceeding the principal removed | yes | bank error |
| correctly assessed, but the owner has since died and estate services confirm it | yes | the death waiver |
| correctly assessed, and reversed as a gesture of goodwill | no | — |
| correctly assessed, and already reversed once | no | — |

A reversal is for the whole of the penalty. Where a penalty of 412.60 USD was assessed but the terms supported 280.00 USD, the reversal credits 412.60 USD; this standard knows no partial credit of 132.60 USD.
